mathematics.assertion_tested: Exact symbolic radial-integral, Green-kernel, boundary area/volume and neutral-charge identities; independently quadrature-check BPS normalization integrals at x=1,2,5,10,30
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Exact symbolic expressions over positive real x,kappa,r,R and rational coefficients; mpmath at 70 decimal digits
mathematics.conventions: x=m_W times ball radius; sectional curvature -kappa^2; -Delta Green=delta; Green vanishes at infinity; all self and pair Coulomb terms use the same finite subtraction
inputs: H3 geodesic-ball metric and radial Laplacian
non_claims: No full finite-boundary gauge partition function is computed
No Yang-Mills hyperbolic nonzero-mode determinant is computed
No physical c_H, proton mass or alpha root is calculated
A numerical residual does not certify quadrature error
